metadata.description: qadri-uk's personal Claude skill library, in three plugins.

plugins.name: qadri-design
plugins.description: Core: UI/UX design skills, proactive-skills instructions, shadcn and chrome-devtools MCP servers. Install this one first.

plugins.name: qadri-motion
plugins.description: Motion, animation, 3D/WebGL, shaders, diagrams and video.

plugins.name: qadri-build
plugins.description: Build and product: React/Next.js, Vercel, Supabase, AI SDK, mobile, data viz, presentations, PM and marketing.

plugins.name: qadri-3d
plugins.description: Advanced 3D and imagery: Three.js graphics, particles, shaders, post-fx, R3F, model-viewer/AR, splats, parallax, WebGL backgrounds.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: obra/superpowers (MIT): brainstorm, plan, test-driven development, systematic debugging, verification before completion, code review. Its SessionStart hook loads the using-superpowers rules into every session.
